cause: A GitHub create_file call omitted the explicit feature-branch argument and therefore used the default branch.
remediation: The exact accidentally added file was deleted using its current blob SHA. No reset, force-push or history rewrite was used.
limitations: The main tree is restored but history retains the add/revert commits.
No other main path changed in the compare from the pre-incident SHA.
The PR branch remains separate and unmerged.
